clue.text: House by pass — one mostly used by writers for a break

definitions.text: used by writers for a break

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house
a col is a mountain pass

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word is kept, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: the word one, written out

explanation.surface: A writer's retreat beside a mountain pass, used for a break from work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'House' is a semi-detached in British usage; 'mostly' trims the final letter of 'one', and 'by' only sets the house beside the pass.
explanation.definitionFit: This punctuation mark is a pause in a sentence, a stop weaker than a full stop.

clue.text: Sorting our post gets us in a dazed state

indicators.note: sorting means these letters are put into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Sorting the mail leaves postal workers in a daze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sorting' looks like a postal job, but it signals that 'our post' is rearranged; 'us' then follows as written.
explanation.definitionFit: Stuporous describes someone in a stupor, semi-conscious and numb.

clue.text: Do rodents mostly go under or across motorway?

parts.note: M1 is Britain's main motorway, written MI in crosswords

indicators.note: mostly means the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: mice are rodents

explanation.surface: Do mice cross the motorway by going under or over it?
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the London–Yorkshire motorway. 'mostly' cuts MICE to MIC, which goes under MI in the down light; 'go under or across' just explains it works either way.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone, in the comedy sense, is to impersonate them.

clue.text: Reporting on being behind bars?

indicators.note: being behind bars is being inside a cage, so the word for on goes inside it

parts.note: a cage is made of bars
over can mean on, as on top of

explanation.surface: A news story about life in prison.
explanation.walkthrough: To be behind bars is to be locked in, so 'being behind' signals putting the word for on inside the barred enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Coverage is the reporting of news events by the media.

clue.text: Noble and common females together spotted insect

parts.note: a lady is a noblewoman; bird is common (colloquial) slang for a woman
a lady is a noblewoman; bird is common (colloquial) slang for a woman

explanation.surface: A titled woman and a commoner spot an insect together.
explanation.walkthrough: The held clue lost the word 'females'; 'bird' is British slang for a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: This small red beetle with black spots is a familiar garden insect.

clue.text: Hose assembled only in final stages of conflagration, alas

indicators.note: assembled means the letters are put together in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: final stages of picks the last letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A fire hose rigged only as the blaze was dying, sadly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'final stages of' picks N and S; 'assembled' rearranges ONLYNS.
explanation.definitionFit: Nylons are women's stockings, and stockings are hose.

clue.text: Prior, in origin, a church official

definitions.meaning: a lay officer in a Presbyterian church

explanation.surface: A monastery prior who began as a church official.
explanation.definitionFit: Elder means older, born before; and Presbyterian churches have lay officers with this title.

clue.text: Officer giving directions on board

indicators.note: on means placed on top of, in a down light

parts.note: E and N are compass points, east and north
a sign is a notice board

explanation.surface: An officer issuing instructions aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' puts EN above SIGN in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: An ensign is a junior commissioned officer in the navy.

clue.text: Branches carried along by the current trend

definitions.text: Branches carried along by the current trend

indicators.note: carried along by means the branches come after the trend

parts.note: drift is a current or trend
wood is branches

explanation.surface: Fallen limbs swept downstream by the river's flow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carried along by' places the branches after the current trend, and the whole clue also describes the answer, so it is an &lit.
explanation.definitionFit: Driftwood is timber washed along by water.

clue.text: Stiff outfit upset little girl

parts.note: a rig is an outfit of clothing

indicators.note: upset means the girl's name is turned upside down in the down light

parts.note: Di is short for Diana

explanation.surface: A rigid costume upsets a small child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns DI into ID.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigid means inflexible or unbending.

clue.text: Impassive, a French executive accepts deliveries right away

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: accepts means the executive takes the next piece inside itself

parts.note: MD, managing director, is an executive

indicators.note: right gives R, and away says that letter goes

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries (balls bowled)

explanation.surface: A French boss stays unmoved while taking in parcels immediately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' takes R from OVER, leaving OVE, which MD 'accepts' to make MOVED. In cricket an over is six balls bowled.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unmoved shows no emotion, just as an impassive face betrays no feeling.

clue.text: Showing inclination to create a record

definitions.meaning: leaning over to one side, as a ship does
an entry in a catalogue or register

explanation.surface: A ship's tilt is noted in the log.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that leans to one side is said to list; and an entry in a directory or catalogue is also called this.

clue.text: Obtain police commander's backing

indicators.note: backing means both pieces are read in the other direction, right to left

parts.note: RUC is the Royal Ulster Constabulary, the former Northern Ireland police
CO is commanding officer

explanation.surface: Getting the support of a senior police officer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns RUCCO into the answer. Obtain here means 'exist, prevail', as in 'conditions that obtain'.
explanation.definitionFit: In the formal sense of to be found or to prevail, obtain means to happen or exist.

clue.text: Receive accolade, say, yet lacking intellect

indicators.note: say tells us that the phrase is to be heard spoken, not spelt

parts.note: an accolade is the tap of a sword that confers a knighthood, so to receive it is to be knighted

explanation.surface: Someone honoured with a knighthood who is nevertheless dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks a soundalike: 'be knighted' spoken matches the answer, whose K-less spelling is entered.
explanation.definitionFit: Benighted literally means overtaken by night, hence in intellectual darkness or ignorant.

clue.text: Old railway skirting field where fruit is cultivated

indicators.note: skirting means going round the edges of, so these letters sit around the field

parts.note: a range is a field or extent, as in range of vision

explanation.surface: An old railway line running alongside a field of fruit trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skirting' means the old railway letters wrap round the field rather than sitting beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A conservatory or greenhouse where citrus trees are grown is called this.

clue.text: Curtailed part of speech, say, about Republican opponent

indicators.note: curtailed means its tail, the final letter, is cut off

parts.note: an adverb is a part of speech

indicators.note: about means the word say surrounds the Republican

parts.note: taken as the word say

explanation.surface: A partly truncated speech about a Republican opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Curtailed' cuts the tail off the part of speech; 'about' puts the Republican inside the word say, which here gives its own letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An adversary is a rival or foe in a contest.

clue.text: Love involved in monk's downfall

indicators.note: involved in means the love letter is wrapped inside the monk

parts.note: Dom is the title of a Benedictine monk
love is nil in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: Love affair brings about a monk's ruin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' puts O inside DOM; Dom is a title given to some monks.
explanation.definitionFit: Doom is ruin or a dreadful fate, the same thing as a downfall.

clue.text: Torment as modern forms of transport turned over

indicators.note: turned over means the whole chain is read backwards

parts.note: RY is railway; a tram is a vehicle
RY is railway; a tram is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Modern vehicles flipped over cause suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses MODRYTRAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Martyrdom is great suffering, death or torture for a cause.

clue.text: In role of doctor in boy's fighting unit

indicators.note: in means these pieces go inside the boy

parts.note: a son is a boy
qua is Latin for in the capacity of

explanation.surface: A boy plays doctor inside a combat group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' places QUADR inside SON.
explanation.definitionFit: A squadron is a military unit, especially in an air force.

clue.text: Endless dispute over dandy's discarded garments

indicators.note: over means above, in a down light
endless means the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a case is a legal dispute
a toff is a dandy; the 's gives S

explanation.surface: A row over a dandy's thrown-away wardrobe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' cuts CASE to CAS; 'over' places it above TOFFS. A toff is British slang for a posh person.
explanation.definitionFit: Cast-offs are clothes discarded by previous owners.

clue.text: Deliver second greeting to old Roman

parts.note: ave is the Latin greeting, hail

explanation.surface: Delivering a second hail to an ancient Roman.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliver someone from danger is to rescue them.

clue.text: Blow in square below housing area, initially

parts.note: SQ is an abbreviation for square

indicators.note: housing means the next piece is held inside the word for below

parts.note: under means below

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of area

explanation.surface: A gust in a town square below a housing estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' puts the first letter of 'area' inside the word for below; 'in' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To blow money is slang for wasting it extravagantly.

clue.text: Mischievous child with skill to pass on

parts.note: an imp is a naughty child
art is skill

explanation.surface: A naughty child with talent to share.
explanation.definitionFit: To impart is to communicate or hand over knowledge.

clue.text: A lot of orders from theatrical backers

definitions.meaning: a group within the nine orders of heavenly beings

explanation.surface: Many commissions come from investors in a show.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatre financiers are called this, and they are also one of the celestial hierarchy's orders.

clue.text: A burning passion

parts.note: not an ardent love but a literal compulsion to set things on fire

explanation.definitionFit: This is the mental disorder of an irresistible urge to start fires, literally a passion for burning.

clue.text: Fielder's aim

definitions.meaning: a cricket fielding position on the off side near the batsman

explanation.surface: A cricket fielder's goal.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a position square on the off side is so named; and an aim is also a purpose.

clue.text: Silk for queen, striped

definitions.meaning: a queen is a female cat
having dark stripes on a grey or brown coat

explanation.surface: Choosing a striped silk fit for a queen.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a watered silk, a female cat (a queen in breeders' terms) and a striped coat pattern.

clue.text: Instrument used in urban jollification

indicators.note: used in means the letters are found within the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A banjo played at a city party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used in' signals the run inside urBAN JOllification.
explanation.definitionFit: A banjo is a stringed musical instrument.

clue.text: Friendly declaration in Muslim territory

definitions.meaning: read as three words, a statement that one is someone's pal
the region under an imam's rule

explanation.surface: An amicable announcement made in a Muslim land.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as I'M A MATE, the answer is a friendly declaration.
explanation.definitionFit: The territory or office of an imam, a Muslim leader, is called by this word.

clue.text: Subtle revolutionary accepts punishment

indicators.note: accepts means the revolutionary takes the punishment inside

parts.note: a red is a revolutionary communist
a fine is a monetary penalty

explanation.surface: A clever rebel takes his penalty quietly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepts' puts the punishment inside the revolutionary; a communist is called a red.
explanation.definitionFit: Something refined is delicate and sophisticated, showing fine distinctions.

clue.text: Examine way to arrange secret meeting

parts.note: to try a case is to examine it in court
St is an abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Checking how to set up a clandestine rendezvous.
explanation.definitionFit: A tryst is a lovers' private appointment or rendezvous.

clue.text: A big blow for caravan travellers

definitions.text: A big blow for caravan travellers

parts.words: A big blow for caravan travellers
parts.note: not a setback for holidaymakers with trailers but a desert wind facing camel trains

explanation.definitionFit: A desert gale whipping up sand is a fierce wind hitting camel trains crossing the desert.
